verdict.rationale: Kimi's own API platform OpenAPI spec lists a batches endpoint, which suggests a first-party way to submit many requests at once. The Kimi Code docs also cite multi-file refactoring across a large codebase, a form of bulk editing. Both are only one-line mentions, with no detail on how bulk operations work or what limits apply. Missing for 10: documented batch job semantics and limits, bulk operations in the assistant app itself, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: /v1 chat completions, responses, Anthropic-compatible messages, batches, files, tool search, and models
